India Warns UN on Sensitive Weapons Tech Transfer to Terror Groups

India has urged global vigilance against the transfer of sensitive weapons technology to entities linked to terrorism. Speaking at the UN, India's representative cautioned that such transfers could empower terrorist groups. The statement emphasized the need for international cooperation to prevent the proliferation of advanced weaponry to non-state actors and terrorist organizations.
